description: 2023 Pineapple Express Flood Structure Status is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by CAL FIRE. Use this app to examine the known status of structures damaged by flooding. If a structure point does not appear on the map it may still have been impacted by flooding. Specific addresses can be searched for in the search bar. Use the imagery and topographic basemaps and photos to positively identify a structure. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher CAL FIRE. Its tags are 2023, 2023XMYEarlyMarchStorms, CAL FIRE, DINS, Damage Inspection. It offers 2 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
